2363-3446-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Herald of Kozilek, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1115-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6273-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-4716.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-6968-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-6968-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1563-2457-7730-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

997-3175-7424.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1806-2060-3129-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7314-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1270-2034-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

560-2919-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-2919-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

775-1409-4365.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

225-539-751-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.
225-539-751-3664.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

1651-2638-5334-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-5334-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-5334-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2292-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4659-5365-5494-6291.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6291.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

222-527-2079-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2079-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1399-1606-4249-4452.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
1399-1606-4249-4452.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

224-573-1772-3470.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2232-4122-6444.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact Elf card in hand that can be cast using {G}{G} or less with enough mana to cast it.
2232-4122-6444.description:
Cast an Elf from your hand by paying its mana cost.
If the Elf was green, Nettle Sentinel triggers, untapping itself.
When the Elf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Holding priority, activate Heritage Druid by tapping it, Nettle Sentinel and another Elf, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Heritage Druid from the battlefield to your hand. 
Cast Heritage Druid by paying {G}.
Nettle Sentinel triggers, untapping itself.
When Heritage Druid enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the Elf cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1418-1645-4826-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3440-4867-5147.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

919-2051-2546-3872.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-2051-2546-3872.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Land's Edge ability, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1150-2018-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

719-1821-4694.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1821-4694.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be a Phyrexian due to Xenograft.
Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token with two +1/+1 counters on it.
The Incubator enters the battlefield as a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature due to March of the Machines and Xenograft.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1558-4428.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1558-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2116-3757-5003.notablePrerequisites: Spiteful Squad has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2116-3757-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spiteful Squad, adding {C}{C}.
Spiteful Squad dies, triggering itself, Felisa and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Spiteful Squad trigger, moving its +1/+1 counters onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Felisa trigger, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token for each counter that was on Spiteful Squad.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Inkling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Spiteful Squad from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

240-643-3082-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting that card onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing that creature.
Repeat from step 4 until Triumph of Saint Katherine is on the battlefield again.
Repeat from step 1.

2269-2567-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
2269-2567-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Avenger of Zendikar, adding {G}.
Avenger of Zendikar dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Avenger of Zendikar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Avenger of Zendikar from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Plant tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

2499-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
2499-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
